notes.title: Available Now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Contestants![/h2]
[b]We see all. We hear all. And now we launch on Nintendo Switch!
[/b]
Nintendo featured our launch trailer! Even they understand the power and worth of a Good Broadcast!

[previewyoutube=EIAOhtAh0sU;full][/previewyoutube]
Ministry of Broadcast launches today, April 30, on Nintendo Switch in North America and Europe. If you're interested in pre-ordering the physical Collector's Edition, you can do so [url=https://www.pm-studios.com/store]here[/url] -- please keep in mind that the physical launch date is not yet confirmed!

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/nintendo/comments/gay4lm/ministry_of_broadcast_is_now_available_on/]Also, please join us on reddit for an AMA! You ask, we answer![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601926/444bd915576af708c18b5fa5a72342f8cbdaa329.png[/img]

As an added bonus, if you buy the game on Switch during launch week, the Regime has approved for you to also get the following Switch titles for super-cheap or free!
[list][*] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/a-robot-named-fight-switch/]A Robot Named Fight![/url] - 90% Off!
[*] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/duke-of-defense-switch/]Duke of Defense[/url] - Free!
[*] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/draw-a-stickman-epic-2-switch/]Draw a Stickman: EPIC 2[/url] - Free!
[/list]

For our friends in Asia, the game launches on the Switch on May 7 -- we will follow up with more information on that soon!

notes.title: The New Gameplay Mode Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Contestants![/h2]
[b]It's here! It's finally here! The all new, Regime-approved Story Mode has finally arrived! And to celebrate the occasion, Ministry of Broadcast is now 20% off!
[/b]
Our latest update is now live on the store, and with this update, we're so proud to be able to offer an additional mode of play for anybody and everybody to try! When we first started development on Ministry of Broadcast, we set out to create a challenging game. But even with that goal, we knew we wanted as many people as possible to enjoy the game. That's why it was very important to us to work on a 'story mode' for the game, something a bit more relaxing and less stressful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601926/36d2188984186f1b79a9a5e79a4f39b41bafd7d6.jpg[/img]

When you start the game, you'll be presented with the choice to play on "Normal" or "Easy". If you select Easy, your experience with the game will allow you to more readily focus on the narrative being woven around you. Level design and puzzles are all the same, but we've relaxed some of the most stringent aspects of the game so you can enjoy a stress-free experience. Kinda nice with the whole pandemic going on, yea?

And we would like to iterate to everybody that there is no shame in playing either mode! Pick what you're comfortable with and enjoy the game! Whichever route you select, you can still gather every collectible, see every line of dialogue, and earn every achievement (except one in Story Mode!).

On top of all that, you can also enjoy some of the additional improvements and bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Added new idle animations to Orange since he gets bored just standing around on the snow and ice
[*] Added some missing dialogue for the collectible shoes
[*] Added Serbian language support
[*] Minor bug fixes/improvements (Standing jump from edge a platform is easier, textbox color mismatches, footstep position on some animations, small design updates, etc).
[/list]

Thank you all, and stay safe!

notes.title: The Quarantine Patch!
notes.content:
[h3]Ciao, Contestants![/h3]
[b]The new update is now live![/b] While we all wait for the virus to blow over, this new update (available immediately!) provides many improvements to the game. We're paying very close attention to all of your feedback, so our patch notes are quite varied. And while you're enjoying all the fancy new improvements, we're going to start working on the next update... and it's safe to say it will be our [i]biggest update yet[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601926/c8f0bb96ebffaead8a6311167ea0bfaa91df207c.png[/img]
[list][*] Italian translations
[*] Player's movement is quicker and more responsive while preserving the "feel" of the game
[*] Optimized the number and position of checkpoints
[*] Fixed parts of the game which were too repetitive (unskippable scenes and dialogues)
[*] Main character is now aware of platforms edges, even on ice
[*] Main character now prefers the closest edge when going down from box or other small platforms
[*] New and tasty chapters screens
[*] Allow Steam screenshot/F12 functionality
[*] Optimized initial loading time
[*] Added save data backup, preventing data loss during edge cases
[*] Lots of small design improvements
[/list]

Stay tuned here and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/OfBroadcast]Twitter[/url] for more news, sneak peeks, and dark humor. Until we meet again, Good Broadcast!

notes.title: Music To Your Ears
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Contestants![/h2]

Tired of listening to the boring sounds of the world around you? Ready to submit your ears to the glory of a good audio broadcast?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601926/dcb47c212ab777099beb95a520ab63b5105fd4ea.png[/img]
We're proud to present our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249030/Ministry_of_Broadcast__Soundtrack/]Regime-approved OST[/url], created by the immensely-talented Benjamin McCulloch and containing 21 unique tracks. [b]The OST will be available on February 28 for only $5.[/b] You can set your favorite track on loop, or vibe to all 21 tracks as a symbolic representation of the 21 attempts it takes you to clear one of our stubborn puzzles, or enjoy it some other third way. Regardless, all proceeds from the OST go directly to Benjamin. Support artists and musicians!


In other news, a few additional announcements to make about some upcoming content!
[list][*] We're happy to see so many players in Italy, so we're going to bring the game to you in Italian! We're aiming for the localization to be available around March 1, but stay tuned for specifics.
[*] More general improvements/polish to various things throughout the game.
[*] [h3]A new mode to enjoy the game![/h3] We designed Ministry of Broadcast to be a difficult game, and the controls we implemented are exactly what we wanted to create. At the same time, we want to provide an experience that everybody can enjoy -- we believe video games should be as inclusive as possible, and should welcome all players regardless of preference, playstyle, skill level, etc. As such, this new mode will be similar to a "story mode" which reduces/eliminates some of the more challenging and frustrating elements. We do not yet have specifics on what this mode will include, but you will have the option to enjoy the game however you prefer!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes No. 1
notes.content:
Hello, Contestants!

Thanks so much to each of you for your support and feedback. We've been taking notes and working on improvements to our gameplay in order to bring a higher level of satisfaction and enjoyment to each of you.

With that said, we are bringing you a patch that addresses certain technical and gameplay issues. 

[b]Make sure you've updated your copy of the game![/b] Please send us feedback when ever you feel you have something to share. We see all. We hear all. 

PATCH NOTES:
[list][*] fixed bug where people were unable to press R to restart the game 
[*] alleviated the difficulty of two places in particular that might be causing people a lot of unnecessary suffering
[*] fixed issues with the connected gamepad not being recognized by the game
[*] fixed issue with the main character jumping forward instead of up in some edge cases
[/list]
